data.name: Ashwatthama
data.gender_notes: Ashwatthama is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aśva, 'horse', + sthāma, 'voice' — 'horse-voiced'. Its root is Sanskrit aśva + sthāma. Ashwatthama, a warrior in the Mahabharata. Ashwatthama is a Sanskrit name meaning “Horse-voiced; a warrior's name”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashwatthama expresses “Horse-voiced; a warrior's name”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashwatthama total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
